== Notes ==
* Only [[attacks]] (including [[wanding]] and [[attack skills]]) will trigger this skill's effect.
* This skill grants energy ''whenever'' you strike a foe with a condition, i.e it does not end upon hitting a foe who is suffering from a condition.
* Energy gain occurs immediately after the hit.
** Attacks that successfully inflict a condition will cause energy gain whether or not the foe is already suffering a condition.
** If [[Reap Impurities]] removes the foe's only condition, it will still cause energy gain.
* Can be very effectively combined with [[Quickening Zephyr]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
